verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes API access (SDK, MCP server, Agent Toolkit) that could let an agent create checkouts and manage payments, and webhooks/refund guides show some transaction-status visibility, but there is no evidence of a payouts endpoint or a documented transactions/payouts listing API for reconciliation into a ledger. missing for 10: dedicated payouts API/endpoint, transaction history/list API, ledger/reconciliation-specific documentation or examples, independent confirmation of agent-driven reconciliation workflows.
